### Added

- *(kagent)* Make claude-sonnet-5-5 the default model in [#863](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/863) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(substrate)* Name the Substrate database with postgres.substrateDatabase in [#876](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/876) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(kagent)* Run kagent 1.5.0 on Substrate 1.6.1 in [#874](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/874) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- Align files according to platform standards in [#853](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/853) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])

### Fixed

- *(hooks)* Bound the hook Jobs' emptyDirs with ephemeral-storage in [#856](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/856) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(make)* Golden-update and verify-target render with the pinned helm in [#861](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/861) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(kagent)* Refuse the api.kagent.dev crossing on the 1.x database in [#860](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/860) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(valkey)* Admit muster and klaus-gateway only on muster-valkey in [#865](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/865) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(model-manager)* Egress admits the model registry and its blob storage in [#872](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/872) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.121.0...v4.122.0
